note: Existing w:ins/w:del/w:moveFrom/w:moveTo, paragraph-mark pPr/rPr ins/del, row-level trPr ins/del, cellIns/cellDel and supported *PrChange markers can be queried through synthetic /revision paths. revision.action=accept|reject supports synthetic and native marker paths; paragraph-mark actions join adjacent paragraphs where OOXML requires it, while row/cell actions remove the enclosing row/cell. add run creates ins/del/moveFrom/moveTo/format revisions; add paragraph supports ins/del/paraMarkIns/paraMarkDel/format; add row supports ins/del and add cell supports ins. set revision.type=format supports existing run, paragraph, table, row and cell paths and snapshots the former property container for reject; set row and cell support ins/del. set with find= supports literal/regex tracked replacement and literal/regex format revisions across consecutive ordinary runs, splitting exactly at the match boundary; a match that enters or crosses a hyperlink, field, drawing or non-text-run boundary fails explicitly. Move sides require the same revision.id and emit Word-compatible range markers.
